title: Config-declared kind aliases for item addresses
description:
Kind-segmented addresses (`@/<kind>/<self-id>`) and `--kind` filters name item kinds by their full `[item_kinds]` registry key. Long kind names make citations heavy in space-constrained text, code comments especially: `@/invariant/atomic-writes`. Add config-declared aliases so a kind can also be named by a shorthand: `[item_kinds.invariant]` declaring `aliases = ["inv"]` makes `@/inv/atomic-writes` resolve to the same item. Aliases live in configuration, keeping the engine domain-agnostic.

## Semantics

- An alias is accepted anywhere a kind name is accepted: the kind segment of project-scope and explicit issue-scope addresses, and `--kind` arguments on `jit item list` / `jit item search`.
- Canonical output is unchanged: `qualified_id` values, list/show output, and rendered projections use the kind's registry name (`@/invariant/…`). Aliases are input sugar.
- Aliases share the kind-name namespace: an alias that duplicates a kind name or another kind's alias is a configuration error, surfaced by the same path that rejects an otherwise invalid `[item_kinds]` table.
- Issue-scope sugar (`<short-id>/<self-id>`) is untouched: aliases contribute no id-patterns and play no part in pattern-shape disambiguation.

## Adoption

The `jit init` scaffold (`crates/jit/src/hierarchy_templates.rs`) and this repository's `.jit/config.toml` declare `aliases = ["inv"]` on the invariant kind. Downstream, the SSOT adoption sweep (`76cb968b`, which depends on this task) uses `@/inv/…` as the citation form in skill files and Rust code comments.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `aliases` parses from `[item_kinds.<kind>]`; `jit item show @/inv/<self-id>` and `jit item list --kind inv` resolve to the invariant kind; canonical `qualified_id` output still uses the registry name.
- [hard] REQ-02: an alias that duplicates a kind name or another alias is rejected as an invalid `[item_kinds]` configuration with a descriptive error; unit tests cover alias resolution and collision rejection.
- [hard] REQ-03: the `jit init` scaffold and this repository's `.jit/config.toml` declare `aliases = ["inv"]` on the invariant kind; `jit item --help` text mentions alias resolution; `jit validate`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, and `cargo fmt --all -- --check` stay green.
